purpose: Byte-for-byte compatibility anchor for the frozen v3 claim-carrying proof envelope while v4 support is added.
source_reproduction: The deterministic fixture was generated in a temporary detached worktree at ca7045a, hashed independently, then regenerated from the current working tree; the worktree was removed after equality was established.
notes: This is a proof-serialization KAT, separate from the transcript-schedule KAT.
It establishes that the legacy v3 prover still emits exactly the pre-v4 bytes for this representative claim-carrying fixture; it does not make v4 a payment proof.
